profile.headline: Software Developer, Identity and Access Management  at Sila Solutions Group
profile.jobTitle: Software Developer, Identity and Access Management
profile.summary: Experienced software developer with a demonstrated history of working in the financial services industry.  Articulate and engaging, skilled at forging and strengthening key professional relationships with internal and external stakeholders to transform requirements into results.  Strong education professional with a Master of Science focused in Computer Science from Fairleigh Dickinson University.

positions.title: Software Developer, Identity and Access Management
Senior Developer
positions.description:
Technologies: Python, Java, shell scripting, Autosys, Sybase, Windows, Linux 

Modernized a legacy COTS cash management application used to exchange time sensitive funds and securities trades with major financial counterparts via the Federal Reserve Bank, including adding High Availability and Multifactor Authentication with a significant impact on business.

Accomplishments:
- Pioneered an innovative new operational framework that strategically established a new suite of job schedules and Python scripts that oversaw the daily operational lifecycle including cutover to a warm standby in the event of a disaster recovery (DR) scenario.
- Leveraged Python and Excel to reverse engineer data feeds from upstream systems and map to downstream Federal Reserve system.
- Enhanced DR turnaround by 75% by extending the operational framework later used as a model to establish a third application instance with minimum configuration changes at a new tertiary site.
- Played a key role in determining the application operational profile generating baseline metrics by developing custom Python monitoring scripts to scrape application logs, augmenting existing corporate monitoring tools. Metrics aided to identify and resolve production issues.
- Built and strengthened key professional relationships with stakeholders at the Federal Reserve to deliver Fed mandated modernization initiatives and roll out changes on time.
- Led application rollovers to redundant datacenters with the aim of ensuring application resiliency.
- Completed comprehensive software enhancements and infrastructure upgrades within time and budget constraints.
- Integrated 3rd party packages (Multi-Factor Authentication, Vormetric, CyberArk) into the application ecosystem to remediate security concerns.

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Technologies: C++, RogueWave libraries, shell scripting, XML, Excel VBA, Autosys, Sybase, Solaris

Drove significant enhancements to a legacy financial derivatives application used as gateway between worldwide upstream Citi front office systems and a centralized back office settlements system. 

Accomplishments:
- Spearheaded major enhancement that aided in upstream migration from a suite of legacy systems to a central new upstream system.
- Played a key role in mass trade migrations between systems, developing customized scripts, extracting pre- and post- migrated data, and creating summaries that leverage pivot tables to assist with cross-check and troubleshooting.
- Established and trained a new offshore support team to optimize operational efficiency across the day to day application management.
- Increased throughput by 14% and processing speeds to up to 15K trades per hour through streamlined monitoring and alert scripts that resulted in application improvements.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Technologies: C++, Java, JSP, Oracle, Windows, Solaris

Strategically led major enhancements to the core business engine, light front-end GUI work, and maintenance of a 3-tier corporate insurance application.

Accomplishments:
- Aligned business needs into results by liaising with actuaries and business analysts to gather information for software requirement specifications.
